title: Boroom bi laaj Yàlla
intro: Benn njiit bu am doole te réy-réy dafa gëmoon ni amul kenn ku gëna mag ci seen jal. Ñu topp mbooloo mu doon daw, jàll ci ndox mu yaatu, waaye ñu daje ak njeexte lu doywaar. Jaar-jaaru buur baa ngi feeñ ci pàcc yu bari ci Al Quran, di artu ñépp.
clues: Njiit lu am doole laa woon, gëmoon ni amul kiliftéef bu ëpp sama kiliftéef ci réew yi ma yor.
Amoon naa benn wazier buma wóolu bu tuddu Haman, mu jàppale ma ci defar ay projet yu mag ci wàllu architecture.
Ma woo luxuskat yi gëna mag ci sama réew ngir ñu werante màndarga yi ab ndaw bu ma doon xeex.
Bañ naa bàyyi nit ñi nekkoon jaam ci sama réew ñu dem, doonte mbas mi ak àrtu yu leer.
Ma topp leen, jàll géej gu yaatu, ànd ak samay soldaar yépp ak samay xare.
Geej googu moo ma tëj, man ak samay soldaar, nu féey ñépp, bi ñuy jàll ci jàmm.

trial.label: Jàngat/Xew-xew
options: Tabax gaal balaa mbënd mu mag
Xare ak Jalut ci vale bi
Fexe ba jënd ak jaay njub

outcome.label: Njureef
options: Ñu daanu ci géej gi ak ay soldaar
Muccal ci yërmande Yalla ak muñ gu fay
Ñu dajewaat ak seeni mbokk ginaaw ay at yu metti
outcome.answer: Ñu daanu ci géej gi ak ay soldaar

arabic: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ
verse: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy. (51:40)
